## Checklist
- [ ] Focused change, described in user-visible terms
- [ ] Shared contract and vectors updated first, when both platforms are affected
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing
- [ ] `python3 scripts/web_check.py` / `python3 scripts/brand/render_icons.py --check` when the site or brand changed
- [ ] No keys, personal data or real health documents in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Privacy wording follows CONTRIBUTING.md (never claim data "never leaves the device")
